name: Hearthfire Bolt (Example)
author: voodoo573
description: EXAMPLE ITEM. You hurl a ball of cosy, crackling hearthfire at a creature you can see. It burns enemies but leaves a pleasant smell of woodsmoke.
summary: Example 1st-level evocation: a ranged fire attack that scales with slot level.

data.name: Hearthfire Bolt (Example)
data.desc: Ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 fire damage and sheds dim light in a 5-ft radius until the end of your next turn. +1d8 per slot above 1st.
